description: This source file defines a PHP trait 'TimesheetPermissionTrait' within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides permission checking functionality for timesheets, ensuring access control based on user roles and employee associations. It uses other traits and classes from the OrangeHRM core API and entity modules.
